SRC-039:R001.text: A checkbox-driven automatic periodic PACK ALL of all archives, configurable interval, hourly default, enabled by default -- implemented as PackingConfig.auto_pack_all_enabled (default True) and auto_pack_all_interval_minutes (default 60, normalized 5..1440), Packing Settings controls wired into the touched-field autosave, one MainWindow auto_pack_timer reconfigured during init and on every Settings save before the audit-fingerprint early return, periodic ticks reusing the manual PACK ALL eligibility and _start_sequential_pack_queue under the AUTO PACK ALL label, skipping an occurrence while any packing work is busy, never packing at startup
